records.evidence_boundary: URJ editor says roundup included only sermons for which written texts were obtained, and cites excerpts and a Temple URL for this sermon. This supports historical access to a written text, not a claim that the editor retains a copy, that the Temple site survives, or that the manuscript has been recovered. historical_editorial_manuscript_evidence.independent_archive_snapshot_result: Wayback/Archive.org public endpoint attempts inaccessible in this environment; no snapshot located or ruled out
historical_editorial_manuscript_evidence.byline_evidence: The URJ publisher page identifies Mark J. Pelavin under 'About the Author'; this credits the compiler but does not establish present-day possession of any manuscript.

records.next_recovery_step: Locate editor-retained 2015 submission or an archival Temple Emanu-El manuscript; any request to publisher or individual requires explicit authorization and no message has been sent.

records.title: The Origins of Awareness — Yom Kippur 5761 (2000)
records.date_basis: Yom Kippur 5761 attribution within sermon reproduction; precise Gregorian date not independently checked
records.publisher: Historical compilation by co-teacher Dr. Stuart Hameroff, presently available through third-party mirrored PDF
records.byline: Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon (explicit attribution within the PDF; Temple Emanu-El, Tucson)
records.sermon_section_heading: The Origins of Awareness — Yom Kippur 5761 — Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon — Temple Emanu-El, Tucson
records.document_compiler_context: Introduction says co-teacher Dr. Stuart Hameroff reprints the course syllabus, his class handout, and Cohon's Yom Kippur sermon; course dated winter 5761, February–March 2001.
records.purported_earlier_source_status: historical URL displayed as PDF source metadata; presently inaccessible; provenance not independently confirmed
records.completeness_boundary: Searchable PDF text contains titled opening and concluding blessing (Ken yehi ratson) on final page. All cited sermon pages were text-visible in the web reader; screenshot attempts for visual PDF QA failed. This is a substantial, apparently complete public reproduction; no independent verification against an author's original signed manuscript or Temple repository.
records.evidence_boundary: External third-party mirror carries the apparent full sermon but is not verified first-party hosting or a rights grant. Do not copy text into repo, declare editorially authenticated original, merge with existing works, or add to 316 blog records. Scientific assertions in 2000 sermon are historical authorial content, not verified contemporary science.

public_textual_crosscheck.observation: Scribd's publicly indexed transcription identifies the same compilation, author, first sermon paragraph and closing; the text could derive directly from the same mirror/source. This is cross-representation consistency, not authorial provenance.

institutional_context.finding: University of Arizona confirms Hameroff's professional affiliation, not this particular jointly taught course or the sermon text.

external_mirror_index.date_limit: Third-party mirrored listing timestamp only; not manuscript creation date, publication approval or first posting date.
